name: Untold Stories 7: Nova Arcana
summary: The seventh installment of the Untold Stories series by renderXR. Somewhat of an experimental CTM in a few aspects, it contains many traditional condensed dungeons that are connected via open cave areas. While intersections guide the player throughout the whacky cave layout, the player has the choice to skip around to other areas if he or she wants to. With a custom currency for trading and a custom healing/spell system to help players through this expansive network of ruins of a long-gone civilization. Adventure into the lonely dark spaces which never seen the light of day.
